headline: Investigation permission sought for former Capital Markets Board (SPK) Chairman İbrahim Ömer Gönül on charge of 'abuse of office'
summary: Investigation permission has been sought for former Capital Markets Board chairman İbrahim Ömer Gönül on a charge of abuse of office, which he disputes.
why: The Capital Markets Board (SPK) is Turkey's securities regulator, overseeing listed markets and unusual share movements.

original_headline: Eski SPK Başkanı İbrahim Ömer Gönül için "görevi kötüye kullanma" suçlamasıyla soruşturma izni istendi
